tools.name: project
tools.description: Project ops: list/get/metadata/flow/map. map returns normalized connectivity in structuredContent.map; includeRaw adds original graph payload.

tools.name: dataset
tools.description: Dataset ops: list/get/schema/preview/metadata/download/create/update/delete. get is summary-first; set includeDefinition=true to include full JSON definition.

tools.name: recipe
tools.description: Recipe ops: list/get/create/update/delete/download. get is summary-first; set includePayload=true to include payload snippets.

tools.name: job
tools.description: Job ops: list/get/log/build/buildAndWait/wait/abort. get is summary-first; set includeDefinition=true to include full JSON definition.

tools.name: scenario
tools.description: Scenario ops: list/run/status/get/create/update/delete. get is summary-first; use includeScript/includeDefinition for details.

tools.name: variable
tools.description: Project variable ops: get/set. set merges provided standard/local keys with existing values.

tools.name: connection
tools.description: Connection discovery (action: infer). Default mode=fast uses DSS connection names; mode=rich scans project datasets for inferred type/schema/managed details.

tools.name: code_env
tools.description: Code env ops: list/get. get returns package summaries; set full=true for full package lists.
